sentences.en: Can you tell me where the nearest antique shop is?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我最近的古董店在哪里吗？

sentences.en: I have a good eye for the value of antiques.
sentences.zh: 我对古董的价值很有眼力。

sentences.en: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
sentences.zh: 他在古董店里偶然发现了一枚旧硬币。

senses.zh: 古时制造的；古董的；古代的
